name: Slapjack
description: On your turn flip a card onto the shared pile or slap the top jack to collect the pile. A wrong slap gives a card to another player. Last player with cards wins. After 140 flips, the most cards wins.
rules: On your turn flip a card onto the shared pile or slap the top jack to collect the pile. A wrong slap gives a card to another player. Last player with cards wins. After 140 flips, the most cards wins.
